395	~you a series of questions.
Breeding stock?  That doesn't sound so bad.
Do you know anything about a precious vase?
Can you tell me about these art collections?

415	~awaiting examination.

417	~are worthy to be mixed with ours.

419	~stock.  If not, you will serve as	
420	~fertilizer.

You would probably enjoy it.  Then	
422	~again, there may be some discomfort	
423	~between the 600th and 800th times.	
424	~Naturally, the second day is worse.

Because we need to continue our	
426	~race.  Since there are no men	
427	~around, we must either use the	
428	~dreaded Gender Bender or capture	
429	~the occasional stranger, such as	
430	~yourself.

It's a machine that changes the	
432	~user's sex.  We disgrace ourselves	
433	~by using it, but it's the only way	
434	~to continue our race.  Unfortunately,	
435	~the effect wears off at unpredictable	
436	~times, so there are some awkward	
437	~moments.

They all died when we won the Great	
439	~Gender War.  Thanks to the Gender	
440	~Bender we had no need for their filth.	
441	~Of course the occasional pet such as	
442	~yourself can be useful.

'Transmorph' is a villager term for	
444	~a Keeper who has had her gender bent.	
445	~They don't think much of our machine,	
446	~and blame us for the lack of men, but	
447	~they serve their purpose.

I am Doctor Slache's assistant.  I	
449	~provide her with sharp instruments	
450	~and clean up after her 'examinations'.	
451	~This is fun.  I don't talk to many	
452	~REAL men.

Sorry, I can't do that.  As much as I'd	
454	~like to, you're a patient and we must	
455	~have a look at you.

Vase?  No.  Sorry.  I'm not much into	
457	~art.  Too bad for you the men are all	
458	~dead.  I heard they used to consider	
459	~art collections a status symbol.  The	
460	~richer ones had huge collections.

Do I look like a history teacher?	
462	~I don't know who had what; that was	
463	~before I was born.

466	~Pyro again.  I had better go see	
467	~what happened.  You stay here.
